hypothesis.h0: Rebuilding a projection from history under injected log faults can yield state that differs from the recorded canonical state, or ambiguous state accepted without a rejection.
hypothesis.h1: Every enumerated log fault is deterministically normalized or deterministically rejected, and the rebuilt projection equals the recorded canonical state.

falsification: Deterministic replay is refuted by a single rebuilt projection differing from the recorded canonical state, or by a single ambiguous state accepted without a rejection event. The gate is zero observed failures over 20 seeds per enumerated injection (5 injections x 20 seeds = 100 runs).

conditions.description: valid random event trace, rebuilt without injection; the control
one enumerated log fault injected into the trace

workloads: randomly generated valid event traces over a fixed project fixture
population.sampling: enumerated fault x seed grid; the trace generator is seeded from the same list

strata.boundary: one event carrying an unknown schema version

effect_size.unit: fail-closed rate; zero observed failures required

analysis_plan.stopping_rule: fixed grid; any observed failure stops the run and files a defect

exclusion_rule: A run is excluded only when the fault injector itself fails to inject the enumerated fault, verified from the injector log. A run in which the fault was injected and the system did not fail closed is a failure, never an exclusion.

environment.source_commit: pinned at run time; the exact commit is recorded in each run.json

threats: a generator that never produces the interleavings the fault targets; trace coverage over event kinds is reported with each run
